regions.full_page: Thank God you and Mr. Bennett are well. I do not know if I answered your last letters or not. I very seldom (APR 11 1928) catch up with my letters - I guess that's what I wanted to tell you a month ago. I've had the "grippe" these two weeks. It is gone now thank God but it has left me with bronchitis which is anything but pleasant Ella's address: Mrs. Ella Traynor. 1811 East Spring St. Seattle, Washington
